# #97 — P2: Handle corrupted JSONL in spool records()

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-06-11T04:07:11Z
Updated: 2026-06-11T04:32:22Z
Closed: 2026-06-11T04:32:22Z

## Finding
`JsonlSpool.records()` calls `json.loads(line)` without a try/except. A truncated JSON line from a crash or kill -9 raises `json.JSONDecodeError`, making the entire spool unreadable.

## Evidence
- `python/openbrain-memory/src/openbrain_memory/spool.py:95-108` — `json.loads(line)` on line 99, no error handling
- The spool is specifically designed as a crash-recovery buffer, so corrupted writes are an expected scenario

## Acceptance Criteria
- Wrap `json.loads(line)` in try/except, skip or quarantine corrupted lines
- Log a warning when a corrupted line is encountered
- Add a test with a corrupted spool file proving records() still returns valid entries

## Source
Post-speed-run review swarm, facade-spool reviewer, adversarial-verified.
